$comment: Share images, social posts and banners, from the agd-playground image editor at /inkbox (src/components/inkbox-og: draw.ts, app.ts, brand.ts, content.ts, layouts.ts; the routes inkbox-og-image, inkbox-social-posts, inbox-social-posts and inkbox-banner all redirect there). The layout rules are the engine's (src/assets/share.ts, the editor's drawDesign kept in its own terms); this file holds the brand's part: colors as token names, themes, sizes, templates, occasions and their copy, and the window's placeholder content. Every hex the editor drew is a token here (see notes); where it had none, the nearest token by color difference is used.
notes: Tokens win where the editor and tokens.css disagree. Headlines: the editor set Funnel Display SemiBold; --ds-font-display is Inter, so headlines are Inter SemiBold (600, --ds-font-weight-semibold). The new-feature card's IBM Plex Sans is Inter too; its mono pill and footer stay IBM Plex Mono (--ds-font-mono).
Ink #3c2c52 and the mist ink #3f2a53 are ink (#3E2A53); purple #74629d is brand; the violet #816daa (tiles, pills) is brand (#74629D); pink #f9b1b4 is pink (#F9B1B5).
Paper #f8fbff is white. Mist #e7eff9 is tag-gray (#EDF2F7) and its line #c4cfe4 is border-default (#D2C9DB). Lavender #f2e2ff is tag-purple (#E9D8FD). Deep #2f2438 is ink (no darker purple token).
The lilac line #beaeda (hatching, outlines, guides, frames) and the lavender line #c9b4e6 are text-faint (#BCB3C5), the nearest token; it is a little grayer than the editor's lilac.

The window is the console, so its colors are the console's tokens: strong #2f2438 is ink, nav #5d4d67 is icon-secondary (#5B4C6A), muted #8679a3 is text-muted (#998EA5), accent #7f69b0 is brand, tint #f4f2f7 and the second rail #f8f7fb are lilac (#F4F2F6), hairlines #ece8f2 are border-subtle (#F3F1F5), the avatar #4f6bed is avatar (#5063B1), the unread tag #dbe8fe and #3b6fd8 are tag-blue and tag-blue-fg, the BETA tag's #fff7f7 is white.
Browser chrome: #f6f4f9 is lilac; the three dots #f2b8b5, #f5d99a, #bfe3b4 are pink, status-warning-bg and status-success-bg; the address ink #8679a3 is text-muted.
Shadows: the editor's rgba(47,36,56,a) uses the ink token at the same alpha.

Left out: the Y Combinator badge (the orange Y square is a third-party mark) and the orange highlight that matched it (#f97316 has no token). The launch and funding occasions keep their words in the pill badge.
The window's placeholder mailbox is Acme: the editor's sample messages named a real person and handle, so none of them ship.
The editor's console screens (public/inkbox-og/screens) are labelled placeholders, so they are not shipped; pass --image for a real capture in the window.
A pasted X post becomes a headline with the author as a small credit in the editor; here pass --headline and --credit (an Acme placeholder in examples, never a real post, name or avatar).

outline.label: Outline

hatch.label: Hatched

funding.label: Big number

announce.label: Announcement

card.label: Card
